This document outlines the equipment inspection II, 
 to be carried out every 1500 operation hours as indicated by H1500 in the 
 title block
Main lube oil Filter function to clean oil from impurities and dirty.

The first draft initiated & prepared by eng. 
 Mustafa Abd El-Hamed El-Deeb & eng. Hala Abd El-Aziz Hashish, tested by eng. 
 Abed Esmail, reviewed by eng. Mohamed Moussa Embaby, revised by eng. Samir Abd 
 El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, accepted by 
 eng. Yosry Abdel Maqsood: general director, 
 and approved by eng. Fathy Ragb: head sector of Talkha PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety Category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust 
 cover" ... etc
Unit must be out of service

Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, ... 
 etc

Remove the dirty filter by gripping the T.P and bottom edges (flanges) of the 
 filter and pulling forward.

Fold dirty filter carefully to trap all collected dirt and place in a box or 
 can for disposal.
Remove new HP filter from box and open it by separating top and bottom panels.

Insert the bottom panel of the filter about half way into the retainer, making 
 sure that the folds in the filter line up with retainer partitions.

With both hands, carefully stretch the top panel up and over the upper ends of 
 the wire dividers in the retainer.

Push both top and bottom panels of the filter in together until the flanges 
 seat against the gasket around the frame. Do not force the filter; if it does 
 not slip into the retainer easily; check to make sure the media pleats are 
 properly aligned with the dividers in the retainer.

Fold the edges of the filter and the flanges over the edges of the filter and 
 the flanges over the gasket of the holding frame to assure.

Replace sealer frame (or pre-filter) so that all edges of the filter are 
 clamped against the gasket on the holding frame and secure with holding clips.

Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection II, 
 to be carried out every 1500 operation hours as indicated by H1500 in the 
 title block
Main lube oil Filter function to clean oil from impurities and dirty.
The first draft initiated & prepared by eng. 
 Mustafa Abd El-Hamed El-Deeb & eng. Hala Abd El-Aziz Hashish, tested by eng. 
 Abed Esmail, reviewed by eng. Mohamed Moussa Embaby, revised by eng. Samir Abd 
 El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, accepted by 
 eng. Yosry Abdel Maqsood: general director, 
 and approved by eng. Fathy Ragb: head sector of Talkha PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety Category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust 
 cover" ... etc
Unit must be out of service
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, ... 
 etc
Work to be carried out
Disassembly
Remove sealer frame (or pre-filter)
Remove the dirty filter by gripping the T.P and bottom edges (flanges) of the 
 filter and pulling forward.
Fold dirty filter carefully to trap all collected dirt and place in a box or 
 can for disposal.
Remove new HP filter from box and open it by separating top and bottom panels.
Assembly
Insert the bottom panel of the filter about half way into the retainer, making 
 sure that the folds in the filter line up with retainer partitions.
With both hands, carefully stretch the top panel up and over the upper ends of 
 the wire dividers in the retainer.
Push both top and bottom panels of the filter in together until the flanges 
 seat against the gasket around the frame. Do not force the filter; if it does 
 not slip into the retainer easily; check to make sure the media pleats are 
 properly aligned with the dividers in the retainer.
Fold the edges of the filter and the flanges over the edges of the filter and 
 the flanges over the gasket of the holding frame to assure.
Replace sealer frame (or pre-filter) so that all edges of the filter are 
 clamped against the gasket on the holding frame and secure with holding clips.
